# Contributing to phpClaw

Contributions are welcome. The contributing guide covers bug reports, branches, the pull request flow, the checks CI runs, testing and releases:

**[phpclaw.ai/docs/contributing](https://phpclaw.ai/docs/contributing)**

Code rules: [phpclaw.ai/docs/code-standards](https://phpclaw.ai/docs/code-standards). Security issues: see the [security policy](SECURITY.md), do not open a public issue.
